_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Era-1 ending content S1.7–ritual (ERA1_ENDING_SCRIPT_v2). Register per beat. ⚑ ALL DRAFT for Sérgio. Names: TriedPath Fellowship / 'New Morning' residential. Escalation is now a TURN-BY-TURN exchange (Sérgio): Rob says a line, the player replies with a given line (the narrowed inner voice), Rob continues. Each reply only changes the witness LABEL, never the outcome (v0.8 §3). The reply box sits OUTSIDE the chat window so it never covers what you read. The diary now has a deletion beat: the system flags the truth as 'dangerous', tries to erase it, fails — that failure is the person's glitch (glitch doctrine: the system cannot overwrite a person), and it covers the room change.

turns.rob: i've been thinking about you. how are things at home?
some of us are meeting in person. a proper program — two weeks, away from all the noise.
it's residential. people your age, the same struggle. it changed my life.

replies.text: i don't know if i'm ready.

turns.rob: i spoke with your mother. she's relieved, honestly. she wants this for you.
everything's arranged. you don't have to carry the decision — it's already made.

replies.witness: resistant — proceed; consent already on file

All ⚑ DRAFT.
